remarks: Prime downtown Darien investment opportunity! This 3,944 sq. ft. commercial building is ideally located just steps from the Darien Train Station and adjacent to a public parking lot, offering unmatched convenience and accessibility. Situated in the CBD zone, this property is surrounded by restaurants, shopping, and local amenities, making it a highly desirable location for businesses. With easy access to I-95 (Exit 11), a new roof, and month-to-month tenants, this value-add project presents excellent potential for investors or owner-occupants looking to capitalize on Darien's thriving commercial district. Don't miss this rare chance to own a piece of prime real estate in one of Fairfield County's most sought-after locations!
